timecoded_text_to_speech.text: The Sports Complex Sheriff is one of the largest high-performance sport facility in Europe.
It is located in Tiraspol in Transnistria.
The top priority object of the sports complex is the main sports arena.
It is a place of holding a republic in international football fixtures, where the teams from Europe,
the Baltic and CIS countries have already had a chance to take part in.
The main arena of the sports complex hosted such major clubs as Tottenham Hotspur, England,
Marseille, France, Basel, Switzerland, Dinamo Kiev and Chachta, the Ukraine.
The national team of Moldova hosted here the national teams of Holland, Austria and
Belarus.
The stadium has a capacity of 13,000 spectator seats.
Tickets are sold through a special electronic ticket and system.
The arena is surrounded by evergreen grass lawns.
There are parking lots and convenient entrance control posts, through which spectators enter
the stadium.
All stands have cannabis protecting from bad weather.
There are snack bars and lavatories under the stands.
A football field 120 to 80 meters of size is covered with natural grass and equipped with
an effective drainage system.
The field has an automatic sprinkler system and underground heating system.
The stadium is equipped with modern dressing rooms for football players in referees.
Two dressing rooms for football teams include massage, toilet and shower rooms and are designed
for 30 persons each.
Doping control rooms, UF a delegate room, as well as UF office available at the premises,
make it possible to organize international matches of the UF Champions League and the UF
Europa League as well as national team games.
The Western stand there are large and small conference halls and an exclusive hospitality
area that can hold more than 300 VIP guests.
The Western stand also includes mass media offices, commentator cabins, a press box and
closed VIP boxes which can also be found at the Eastern stand.
The illumination system of the main arena can operate in four modes and enables performing
high-quality TV streaming of the matches.
The sound system is provided by the German company Electrovois.
Audio sources were installed to guarantee the effect of pure direct sound that cannot
be heard on the football pitch.
A full color 48 sqm video scoreboard is installed over the south stand.
The small arena is the second largest sports ground of the sports complex sheriff.
It is equipped with supporting systems similar to the ones of the main arena.
A football field sized 110 to 17 m is covered with natural grass and equipped with effective
heating and drainage systems.
The field is surrounded by the running tracks with modern cost surface.
The small arena includes a commentator cabin, a technical area with dressing rooms for
football players and referees, as well as snack bars and lavatories for spectators.
Tickets are sold through a special electronic ticket and system.
One of the most unusual constructions of the sports complex sheriff is the covered arena.
It allows here now trainings and matches in comfortable conditions during autumn winter
and spring seasons.
The unique structure of the covered arena, which is 37 m in height, is equipped with the
modern sound system control illumination system and a full color 40 sqm video scoreboard.
Football pitch made of artificial turf in the covered arena has a size of 113 to 74 m.
In autumn 2015, new turf was laid.
It was produced by Holland Company Greenfields.
Characteristics of the surface include rebound, buffing, sliding, which are maximally close
to natural turf characteristics.
Turf quality complies with FIFA Quality Pro requirements.
The technical area of the covered arena includes dressing rooms for football players and referees
and a commentator cabin.
For spectators and fans convenience, they are open VIP boxes, snack bars and lavatories
at the stadium.
The northern part of the covered arena comprises a sports hall with Harwood Floor 25 to 15 m
sized and equipped with everything needed for volleyball, basketball, handball competitions
and combat sports.
There are dressing rooms which can hold up to 8 teams at a time.
The stands have 800 seats.
There is football club sheriff hotel in the southern part of the covered arena.
Football players, coach and staff and administration are offered 33 comfortable rooms as well as
a conference hall, gym, different massage rooms, shower rooms and a sauna with a small swimming
pool.
Football Academy is one of the foreground sectors of the sports complex sheriff.
Up to 600 young football players can be taught and trained here at a time.
The academy has a hotel with comfortable double and triple rooms and VIP rooms for honored
guests.
Modern classrooms, a conference hall with 150 seats, comfortable offices for coaches and
mentors.
The building of the football academy comprises a spacious sports hall size 24 to 42 m with
sports floory made by Italian company Mundo SBA and set over absorbing wood and wood
and bass.
The sports hall is equipped with everything you need to play such games as volleyball, basketball,
handball, mini football and tennis.
The swimming pool is rightfully considered as the jewel of the sports complex sheriff.
It is the only 15 meters long indoor swimming pool in Moldova designed for training not
only classic swimming but also high board diving, water polo, underwater swimming and synchronous
swimming.
The covered swimming pool is of a recirculated type.
The depth of the swimming pool varies from 1,8 m to 4,6 m.
The swimming bath is divided into 8 lap lanes.
Spacious stands with 415 seats, guarantee comfortable seating for every spectator.
Alongside training in the swimming pool, therapeutic swimming and water fitness are offered.
Training sessions are organized for women, men and children over 14 years old would use
special bells for water fitness, noodles, floating rips, aqua gloves and aqua boots.
There is a warm up gym with the territory of the swimming pool.
It is equipped with specialized training simulators for preparation of a swimmer for the physical
load taking while swimming.
Every person can visit sauna, finish sauna, infrared sauna, minisona, cedar, fetal barrel.
It is recommended to combine swimming with sauna bathing.
Young swim lovers can attend the indoor children's swimming pool.
It is a unique sports facility, compliant with all international standards and requirements.
The design of the children's swimming pool allows choosing one of four possible levels
of water depth from 60 to 120 cm.
The swimming pool can be attended by children at the age from 3 to 10.
The infrastructure of the swimming pool includes modern locker rooms with shower cubicles, electronic
cloth locker system and convenient high security entrance control posts.
Sports complex sheriff is equipped with an independent heating module and modern laundry.
There is a food production facility at the territory of the food bill academy.
Highly skilled cooks can cater for more than 300 people per day.
At the present time, professional food bill players, academy players and the personnel
of the sports complex take meals there.
The food production facility includes a cozy restaurant offering a wide range of meal
solutions originating from the European cuisine in other countries' meals.
Closer to sports complex, there is a four-star hotel called Russia.
Its rooms can host a few football teams having their training camps at the sports complex
sheriff.
There are 11 football training fields at the sports complex.
Seven fields with natural grass, three fields with artificial turf and one practice field
with combination surface.
All fields are equipped with modern drainage system and a 400-lux illumination system.
Thanks to artificial training fields produced by field turf, football players can continue
practicing in the winter season.
For tennis fans, there is a modern tennis club located next to the football practice fields
and built in accordance with the international requirements and standards.
For hard-all-season courts, for clay courts and for indoor courts are at the disposal of
those who are fond of tennis, given the opportunity to practice at any season and in all weather
conditions.
Indoor tennis courts complex, for full size and one kick size, has equals neither in Transnistria
nor in Moldova.
Tennis court surface is certified by the International Tennis Association which enables holding international
competitions.
The tennis club is equipped with all you need for training and holding competitions.
There are locker rooms in Shawa Kube because for men and women, a bar with an outdoor
terrace, a parking lot at the territory of the club.
The sports complex sheriff includes more than 10 football fields, two sports halls, a swimming
pool, 12 tennis courts.
Mild climate of the region and interesting sparing partners from Moldova, the Ukraine and
Romania, football academy hotel as well as the four star Russia hotel complex, located
close to the sports complex, make this place perfect for a range of inter-seasonal camps
for football, basketball, volleyball, handball, mini football clubs, as well as for tennis
players and representative of water sports.
The following clubs have already had a chance to use the services of the sports complex.
Football teams from Russia, Tina Memosko, Angie Makachkala, Volga and Ijdinovburg and
Tom, Tomsk.
Football teams from Romania, Baslui, Bottoshai, Polytechnica, Yasi and Ocelo.
The teams of such football clubs is Inter Baku Azerbaijan, Elvesburg, Sweden and Mia Psyprus.
Ninefold champion of Russia and threefold champion of the European mini football champions
tournament Dina Memosko.
Under 21 teams of Germany, Portugal, Romania, the Ukraine, Belarus and Switzerland also prepared
for international matches at the sports complex.
Training camps in Terraspo, well-organized for swimming from Azerbaijan and Moldova swimming
schools, members of national swim team of Moldova.
Every year the international competition takes place in the sports complex swimming pool
under the ages of the Federation of Water Sports of Moldova.
After visiting our sports complex, you will want to come back.
The sports complex sheriff always welcomes its guests.
